purpose: Durable negative evidence from the corrected period-compatible Snes9x 1.51 progression replay before the final acceptance discriminator.

baseline.note: The armed runtime baseline rules out an already-completed ordinary medal matrix as the explanation for the bounded negative result.

bounded_result.frontend_behavior_after_lua_terminal_sta: The historical Lua bridge terminated its Lua thread, while the emulator frontend remained alive at the terminal guest frame until the workflow watchdog.

related_retained_evidence.current_core_raw_input_fidelity: analysis/generated/historical-2014-first-race-replay.json records divergence beginning at sampled frame 440; raw current-core replay is therefore not an equivalent substitute for the period-compatible movie path.
related_retained_evidence.period_reference: analysis/generated/historical-2014-first-race-reference.json records first active race at frame 794 and first race-results state at frame 2874.

rules_out: A medal award occurring at or before guest frame 200000 on this exact corrected Snes9x 1.51 replay.
An already-completed ordinary rows 0..7 medal matrix at the armed runtime baseline.
does_not_rule_out: A later game-authored medal award in the same historical movie.
A replay that reaches authentic races but does not yet complete the award-producing tour/accomplishment before the previous bound.
interpretation.next_discriminator: Extend the same period-compatible replay under a bounded watchdog while retaining race-entry, race-results-entry and track-transition counters, then accept only a model-valid game-authored medal mutation followed by fresh-process reload.
